# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 27 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Thanksgiving Hymns Column 27 where the three translators significantly diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 27:2 — "host of Your works" — meaning of tseva'

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-host-of Your works" | Literal tseva' ma'asekha |
| LOGOS | "the host of Your works" | Same without hyphenation |
| PNEUMA | "the vast array of Your works" | Dynamic expansion of tseva' |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. "Host" is the standard DSS rendering of tseva' and preserves the military-liturgical ambiguity. PNEUMA's "vast array" loses the specific connotation.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 27:6 — "fountain" vs. "wellspring" vs. "source" — water imagery for truth

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-fountain-of [...] truth" | Literal maqor |
| LOGOS | "the wellspring of [...] truth" | "Wellspring" as a slightly elevated synonym |
| PNEUMA | "the source of [...] truth" | Abstract rendering |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. "Wellspring" preserves the water imagery of maqor while adding the connotation of abundance. PNEUMA's "source" is too abstract and loses the water metaphor.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 27:8 — "regulation" vs. "ordering" vs. "how each one would act"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-regulation-of all their works" | Literal choq/mishpat |
| LOGOS | "the ordering of all their works" | "Ordering" conveys divine governance |
| PNEUMA | "You determined how each one would act" | Paraphrastic expansion |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. "Ordering" captures both the divine decree and the resulting structure. PNEUMA's paraphrase dissolves the nominal construction.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 27:12 — "host of the angels" vs. "armies of angels"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-host-of the-angels" | Literal tseva' ha-mal'akhim |
| LOGOS | "the host of the angels" | Standard rendering |
| PNEUMA | "the armies of angels" | Military connotation emphasized |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. "Host" preserves the dual military-liturgical sense of tseva'. PNEUMA's "armies" restricts the meaning to the military alone and loses the cultic-service dimension (cf. 27:13 "their service").

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 27:14 — "princes" — angelic hierarchy term

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-princes-of [...]" | Literal sarim |
| LOGOS | "the princes of [...]" | Standard rendering of angelic rank |
| PNEUMA | "the rulers of [...]" | Dynamic equivalent |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. "Princes" is the standard DSS rendering for the angelic sarim (cf. Daniel 10:13, 20-21 where Michael is called "one of the chief princes"). "Rulers" is too generic.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---
